episodes.title: Tony Alamo: Inside Arkansas' Most Infamous Cult: Part 2
episodes.description: Long before Tony Alamo's empire collapsed, federal investigators had already begun uncovering a pattern of abuse, manipulation, and control that stretched back for decades. What once appeared to be a powerful religious ministry would ultimately become one of the most shocking criminal cases in Arkansas history. In Part 2, we follow the investigations that finally brought Tony Alamo to justice. We examine the allegations from former members, the FBI investigation, the federal trial, his conviction, and the lasting impact his organization left on survivors and communities across Arkansas. This is the story of how one of the state's most infamous cult leaders was finally held accountable. episodes.title: Tony Alamo: Inside Arkansas' Most Infamous Cult. The Rise and fall of a Predator disguised as a Savior.
episodes.description: Long before Tony Alamo became one of America's most notorious cult leaders, he was a traveling evangelist with a growing following. What began as a small religious movement would eventually evolve into one of the most infamous cults in Arkansas history. In Part 1, we explore Tony Alamo's early life, the creation of the Alamo Christian Foundation, how he built his influence, and the methods he used to gain complete control over his followers. This is the story of how faith, manipulation, fear, and absolute authority transformed a ministry into something far more dangerous. Part 2 picks up where this episode ends, following the investigations, criminal allegations, federal prosecution, and the events that ultimately brought Tony Alamo to justice.
